detail.longDescription: Half of all AI-related CVEs are in agent orchestration middleware. Google GTIG counted 2,076 AI-stack CVEs since Jan 2025, with orchestration disclosures up 347% in 2026. Flowise and Langflow ship code execution nodes, and prompt injection or a crafted workflow JSON reaches them. Sandbox the orchestrator as an RCE surface. https:// cloud.google.com/blog/topics/t hreat-intelligence/vulnerability-discovery-and-exploitation-trends-in-the-ai-era # AIAgents # Cybersecurity # InfoSec
